en.text: We buy what is at its best and the menu changes with the season. When a dish runs out, it runs out.

en.text: The rules require us to declare 14 groups of allergens, such as gluten, dairy, egg, nuts, fish or shellfish. If you are unsure about a dish, ask.

es.text: La normativa obliga a informar de 14 grupos de alérgenos, como gluten, lácteos, huevo, frutos secos, pescado o marisco. Si dudas de un plato, pregunta.

es.text: Siempre hay platos sin carne ni pescado. Dinos qué comes y qué no y te decimos cuáles sirven.
